problem:
Let $F=GH.$ What is the value of ${f}_{12}$, if

$$
G=[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 4 & -2\end{aligned}],\,H=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 \\ 6 & 5\end{aligned}]?
$$
worked_solution:
Multiplying the $1$st row in $G$ by the $2$nd column in $H$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{12} & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ 5\end{aligned}] \\  & =2\cdot 3+3\cdot 5 \\  & =6+15 \\  & =21.\end{aligned}
$$
